reason: A usage analytics plugin for DeepSeek Harness that aggregates local token and cost data, provides budget tracking and alerts, displays usage visualizations, and exports Markdown reports.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 汇总本地会话的 token、轮数、步数和估算费用，提供预算进度、告警、用量可视化与 Markdown 报表导出。
summaries.en: Aggregates local DeepSeek Harness session tokens, steps, rounds, and estimated costs with budget tracking, alerts, usage visualizations, and Markdown report export.

capabilities: Aggregates local session token, round, step, and estimated cost data
Persists usage records in local storage
Displays usage dashboards, contribution grids, budgets, and alerts
Exports Markdown usage reports to a local directory
Rescans local session logs and supports configurable model pricing
